scope: Automatic battleship command: retain but hide/gate manual capital controls, and execute destination/hold/range/withdrawal orders.
owner_authority: keep all the controls there, but hide them
owner_playtest_of_preceding_encounter: projectiles work well. And everything works well.
implementation: Manual capital buttons/hints/reticle hidden; keyboard flight input gated. Both exterior drags orbit the camera and return behind on release.
Original manual implementation retained for shuttles and surface flight. Walking inputs do not steer the capital or cancel its order.
Approach orbit/Atlas use automatic planetary routes; Hold position cancels. Keep combat range targets 35 km; Withdraw targets 85 km and never approaches when already farther away.
Six-second eased paths, 1 km standoff tolerance and 0.45 rad/s bounded shortest-angle heading changes are provisional prototype choices.
Navigation continues while walking and switching room/exterior views. Pause/routes/focus loss/context recovery freeze orders; recovery remains paused.
Hangar launch parks the capital before moving control to its shuttle. Ship change/reset, explicit hold and terminal combat outcomes stop navigation.
Reload restores saved position/orientation with no stale order. Weapons and ammunition remain independent of navigation.

test_notes: First navigation attempt looked for console-only controls while walking after a voyage reset. Corrected native view transition; all six groups passed.
First combat regression passed eight groups, then a source edit triggered a development reload and removed temporary combat. Full rerun after source stabilization passed nine groups.
Navigation suite ran before the final hangar-launch stop guard. Subsequent interior suite verified that exact active-course launch behavior. Remaining runtime source unchanged.
Model tests preceded the hangar-launch stop guard; the later production build and browser suites used final runtime source.

rendered_review.method: Direct inspection of native Chrome exterior approach, command-console and narrow combat-order images.
rendered_review.findings: Orders use existing glass panels. Capital manual prompts are absent; command and combat controls remain readable and scroll within narrow bounds.

knowledge_lookup.result: Three unrelated video-course source records; no implementation reused. No navigation-coverage or catalog-wide absence claim.

limits: Kinematic prototype routes, coarse planetary clearance and one stationary practice target. Not a physical thrust model or general tactical path planner.
Range/withdrawal is positional navigation, not projectile-aware automatic evasion. No new weapon, progression, inventory, enemy AI or crew system.
The scale/performance script was adapted to the new capital input policy but not rerun. Older long terrain, quality and fallback-depth receipts remain historical.
Physical phones/laptops, other browser engines, Electron runtime, long play and fresh agent sessions remain untested. Narrow viewport checks do not establish phone performance.
Repository safety helper fixtures were not rerun; the prior six passing checks remain historical and no transfer helpers changed.
No commit, push, deployment, transfer, paid generation or research submission.
